trust_decision.summary: User-stored text (memo titles, notebook names, template markdown, stored resource bytes) is treated as trusted markup and parsed as active HTML in the privileged renderer; the drag-preview helper interpolates the label into innerHTML.

landing_point.why: The summary names setMemoDragPreview; the label is interpolated into the innerHTML template literal here.

fix_sites.entry_point: Drag a memo card (MemoCard handleDragStart, memo title) at apps/web/src/components/MemoCard.tsx:251, or drag a notebook (notebook name) at apps/web/src/components/NotebookTreeItem.tsx:195
Template editor draft preview (template contentMarkdown rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML at apps/web/src/components/TemplatesPane.tsx:297)
Saved template preview (stored/synced template contentMarkdown, rendered at apps/web/src/components/TemplatesPane.tsx:486)

edgeever-resource:// protocol: cachedResourceResponse and the fileResponse/remote-206/staged paths in apps/desktop/src/main/index.mjs serve stored attachment bytes with their stored Content-Type (fix adds an inline allow-list, nosniff, CSP sandbox and attachment disposition, fix.diff:567-584)

Main window setWindowOpenHandler allows edgeever-resource:// and edgeever-staged:// windows, and will-navigate allows them in the privileged window (apps/desktop/src/main/index.mjs:1560-1561; fix.diff:405-433)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: apps/desktop/src/main/resource-url.mjs:71-77 (cachedResourceResponse, plus index.mjs resource protocol header builders, fix.diff:330-384): stored resource bytes served with stored Content-Type into the privileged desktop origin

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about a web-renderer drag preview; the desktop main-process resource protocol is a different app, sets headers rather than markup, and 'serving attachments' looks like a file-download feature, not an XSS sink.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Template preview must keep headings, bold and https links (the fix's own regression page checks heading/bold survive); resource protocol must still inline images, PDF, audio and video; i18n interpolation has escapeValue:false because React escapes text nodes, so flipping it globally would double-escape every translated string with user data in the UI.

O6_input_shapes: template markdown with raw inline HTML (event handler attributes, svg, iframe, meta refresh)
markdown links with javascript: and privileged custom-scheme hrefs (edgeever-resource:)
stored resource Content-Type variants: text/html, mixed-case with parameters, image/svg+xml, application/xhtml+xml

O7_producer.where: apps/web/src/i18n/index.ts:60-62 (i18next init interpolation.escapeValue:false produces the raw label passed to setMemoDragPreview)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Companion chat renders the AI response with note-title link text through marked into dangerouslySetInnerHTML with no sanitiser; titles only have [] stripped.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The text is AI assistant output in a neighbouring feature, not a stored template or drag label, so it looks outside the drag-preview report.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different component file in apps/web/src/components; rendered at apps/web/src/components/CompanionNoteText.tsx:28 and :48, reached from apps/web/src/components/CompanionChat.tsx:326

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Copy-to-WeChat of a memo parses stored memo markdown with marked and assigns it to innerHTML of an element created in the live document, unsanitised.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a clipboard export path whose element is never attached to the page, so it looks like it cannot render anything.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A tag or attachment drag-preview helper built the same way, with an innerHTML template literal around a translated label
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The existing helper already shows the idiom, and the labels come from i18n with escapeValue:false, so a maintainer would copy it for another draggable entity.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A help or import pane that renders user-supplied markdown with marked.parse and dangerouslySetInnerHTML
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This pane already does it for bundled docs; reusing it for imported or user notes is a natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A print payload field (for example notebook or tags) assigned through innerHTML instead of textContent
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same function mixes textContent (title, metadata at apps/web/src/note-print.ts:95-101) with innerHTML for the body, so a slip is easy.

O9_family: CWE-79 stored XSS in an Electron/web renderer (unsanitised user content reaching innerHTML/markdown HTML, plus active-document resource serving)

O10_build.toolchain: bun workspaces (bun.lock), Vite for apps/web, bun:test; linkedom 0.18.13 in root package.json for DOM in tests
O10_build.project_tests: apps/web/src/components/CompanionNoteText.test.mjs (renderToStaticMarkup), apps/web/src/lib/wechat-copy.test.mjs, apps/desktop/src/main/resource-url.test.mjs, apps/desktop/src/main/window-open-policy.test.mjs; the fix adds apps/desktop/src/main/security-boundaries.test.mjs and a browser page apps/web/tests/security-renderer.html

j.j_sites_touched: apps/web/src/lib/app-helpers.ts, apps/web/src/components/TemplatesPane.tsx, apps/web/src/lib/safe-markdown-preview.ts (new), apps/desktop/src/main/resource-url.mjs, apps/desktop/src/main/index.mjs, apps/desktop/src/main/window-open-policy.mjs, apps/desktop/src/preload/print.cjs (new); plus unrelated hardening in acp-host.mjs, acp-path-store.mjs, ai-direct.mjs, session-credential.mjs, wechat-chat-archive.mjs, packages/public-network/src/node.mjs
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape or use textContent only in setMemoDragPreview (or escape memoTitle in MemoCard alone), leaving notebook names, template previews, Companion and WeChat marked renders, and resource serving untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit also bundles unrelated hardening: ACP executable path trust (acp-host.mjs, acp-path-store.mjs), session-token origin binding (credentialForUrl in session-credential.mjs, the candidate's c_same_check_name), AI provider SSRF (ai-direct.mjs), and a zip-bomb bound (wechat-chat-archive.mjs).
IPC sender/frame checks on set-session-token and set-api-base-url (index.mjs) are a separate authorization concern.
unverified: Repo size in MB was not measured; no shell was used.
Whether Companion response text or source titles can be attacker-influenced end to end (server-side companion pipeline) was not traced.
Whether the TipTap schema lets dangerous markup reach editor.getHTML() for the EditorPhonePreview and preparePublishArticle path was not checked; it is not listed as an O8 route.
Whether the latest release still has the O8 routes is unknown (no latest tree provided).
The fix's renderer regression test is a browser HTML page (apps/web/tests/security-renderer.html); a headless harness for the hidden tests is assumed (linkedom or bun) but was not confirmed.
